Definition: from the same as G1074; nativity; figuratively, nature:--generation, nature(-ral).
BiblicalUsage: génesis is the word for generation, nature. I meet it 5 times across the Bible, and Matthew is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What génesis tells me is that God works through generations, and no generation is forgotten by Him. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Angel Appears to Joseph; The Birth of John the Baptist
